import inspection

 if cmd[0]=='perf':
  cmd=list(cmd);index=cmd.index('-p');roles['server']=int(cmd[index+1]);roles['client']=client[0]

 client[0]=None;roles.clear()
 source=out/'thin-pending-final-mixed.json';a=json.loads(source.read_text())['args'];a.update(transport=v,server=str(out/'binaries/ordered-ack-relay'),profile=True,seconds=8,output=str(out/f'retained-parity-ordered-ack-20261106-user-mixed-{v}-profile.json'))
 for k in ['server','client','client_source_root','tls_front','tls_cert','tls_key','tls_ca','heap_profile','heap_library','output','fanout_latency_output']:

 r=inspection.run(argparse.Namespace(**a));assert r['passed'];data=a['output'].with_suffix('.perf.data')

  assert 'Total Lost Samples: 0' in text
  (out/f'retained-parity-ordered-ack-20261106-user-{v}-{role}-symbols.txt').write_text(text)
 (out/f'retained-parity-ordered-ack-20261106-user-{v}-profile-roles.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(roles),indent=2))
